action_class_rule: Action classes are fixed labels derived one-to-one from recorded missing standing dimensions. They identify what kind of explicit institutional property would have to exist for that dimension to pass. They do not identify a specific actor, legal conclusion, declaration value, or executable remediation.
claim_ceiling: This study may characterize only the structure of missing standing dimensions already observed in the closed CA-3 authority-discrimination result. It cannot establish authority, identify the legally correct actor, recommend or select a channel, create a declaration value or derivation rule, establish rights/provenance/legal clearance, authorize SOURCE_MANIFEST population, infer causal root cause, or establish cross-source generality.
forbidden_inferences: lowest gap cardinality implies preferred channel
lowest gap cardinality implies easiest lawful channel
pending counsel workflow implies counsel authority
missing authority act may be supplied by evaluator
missing deterministic rule may be invented by evaluator
frequency_rule: Frequency is exact count of failed channels containing the dimension or mapped action class. Counts are descriptive only and do not imply importance, priority, causal weight, or institutional preference.
gap_signature_rule: For each frozen failed channel, gap_signature is the lexicographically sorted exact set of missing_dimensions already recorded in the closed execution result. No dimension may be added, removed, reinterpreted, weighted, or inferred.
lowest_gap_cardinality_rule: For each target field, compute the minimum exact count of missing_dimensions among its frozen candidate channels and list every channel tied at that cardinality. This is descriptive proximity only. It does not select, rank, recommend, authorize, or prefer a channel.
possible_result: The analysis may show multiple equally low-cardinality channels for a field or no meaningful reduction beyond the common authority-act dimensions. That is valid and must not trigger selection.
success_rule: AUTHORITY_GAPS_CHARACTERIZED_CA3 if all sixteen frozen failed channels are reproduced exactly from the closed result, every recorded missing_dimension is mapped through the frozen one-to-one action-class table, all six fields receive a gap-cardinality characterization, and zero analysis findings occur.
